This policy explains what you pay, how your plan renews, how to cancel, and when you can get your money back. Please read the Key terms first.

WellPeps, a Wyoming corporation (“WellPeps,” “we” or “us”), is not a medical practice or a pharmacy. Independent licensed clinicians provide your medical care. State-licensed pharmacies prepare and ship your medication. This policy covers what you pay through checkout and how we handle your payments.
1. Key terms

rows: One monthly price for the treatment plan you choose. You see it at checkout before you enter your card. It covers your medication (if prescribed), your clinician’s review and follow-up care, messaging with your care team, education and standard shipping. There is no membership fee, no setup fee and no cancellation fee. Lab tests, if your clinician recommends them, are billed separately. Tax is added where the law requires it.

blocks.text: 2. The free health assessment
2.1 What “free” means

Starting your health assessment is free. You do not pay a separate fee for the assessment or for your clinician’s review. You pay one monthly price for the treatment plan you choose. If your clinician decides not to prescribe, we refund everything you paid (Section 5.1).
2.2 How it works

items: Choose a treatment and answer health questions in the patient portal.
Check out. Before you enter your card, you see the monthly price and the renewal terms.
An independent licensed clinician reviews your answers. This is usually done online. The clinician may ask you for more information.
If the clinician prescribes, the prescription goes to a state-licensed pharmacy that prepares and ships your medication.
If the clinician does not prescribe, you get a full refund.

blocks.text: 2.3 A prescription is not guaranteed
Paying does not guarantee a prescription. A licensed clinician decides whether treatment is medically appropriate for you. WellPeps does not make that decision and cannot change it.
2.4 When your card is charged
Your card is charged at checkout, before your clinician reviews your answers. That is why we refund you in full if you are not prescribed treatment. [ALTERNATIVE A: charge only after approval]
3. Automatic renewal

blocks.heading: Your plan renews every month.
blocks.text: When you check out, your plan starts. It then renews automatically every month until you cancel. Each month we charge the card you used at checkout the monthly price you saw at checkout, or the new price if we told you about a change under Section 6. We charge on the [same calendar day each month] as your first charge. If a month has no such day, we charge on the last day of that month.

blocks.heading: No minimum commitment.
blocks.text: You can cancel at any time. There is no cancellation fee.

blocks.heading: Your consent.
blocks.text: Before we charge your card, we show you the renewal terms in plain words and ask you to check a box that says you agree. The box is not checked for you. It is separate from the other boxes you check, such as your agreement to the Patient Terms of Service and Payment Agreement and your consents to telehealth care. If you do not check it, we do not charge you and your plan does not start.

blocks.heading: What we send you.
blocks.text: We send you:
Right after checkout: an email with the renewal terms, the price, the date of your next charge and how to cancel.
After each charge: a receipt.
At least [7 days] before each renewal: a reminder with the date, the amount, the cancellation deadline and how to cancel.
At least once every 12 months while your plan is active: a reminder of the same details. (A reminder before each renewal counts.)
Before any price change takes effect: a notice (Section 6.2).

blocks.heading: Your consent record.
blocks.text: We keep a record of what you agreed to: the words we showed you and the date and time you agreed. We keep it for at least [3 years], or for 1 year after your plan ends if that is longer. You can ask us for a copy.

blocks.heading: Renewals depend on your clinician.
blocks.text: Your clinician decides whether to renew your prescription. If we charge you for a renewal and your clinician does not renew your prescription, we refund that charge in full (Section 5.1).
4. How to cancel
4.1 Ways to cancel
**In your patient portal:** sign in at portal.wellpeps.com and send us a message that says you want to cancel.
**By email:** write to support@wellpeps.com from the email address on your account and say you want to cancel.
**By phone:** (307) 881-8700, during normal business hours
You do not need to call anyone, talk to a chatbot, give a reason or enter your card again. We may ask one question to confirm it is you. We will not make cancelling harder than signing up.
4.2 We confirm in writing

We confirm your cancellation by email within 1 business day. The email shows when we received your request, when your plan ends and whether any more charge will be made. Your request counts from the time we receive it. If you do not get the email within 1 business day, contact us. Keep the email.
4.3 The cancellation deadline
To be sure you are not charged for your next month, cancel at least [72 hours] before your next charge date. Your reminder email shows that date.
You can still cancel after the deadline, and we will still stop all future charges. If you cancel less than [72 hours] before your next charge date:
If the pharmacy has not started preparing your medication, we cancel that order and refund the charge in full. If we have not made the charge yet, we will not make it.
If the pharmacy has already started preparing your medication, the charge is not refundable and your order will ship. We will not charge you again.
4.4 What happens after you cancel
You will not be charged again after we confirm your cancellation, except as stated in Section 4.3.

Your plan stays active through the month you have already paid for. You can keep messaging your clinician in the patient portal through the end of that month. [VERIFY: portal access after cancellation]
Medication that the pharmacy has already started preparing for that month cannot be refunded, except as stated in Section 5.
Talk to your clinician before you stop a prescribed medicine. Your clinician can tell you how to stop safely and what other options you have.
4.5 Restarting

You are welcome back at any time. Sign in to the patient portal or message us. A clinician will review your current health information before treatment starts again, and you will see the price and renewal terms again at checkout. We do not offer a pause.
4.6 If we end your plan

We may end your plan if your clinician stops treatment, you move to a state we do not serve, a payment fails (Section 7), you give false information, or you misuse the service or the medication. We will tell you in writing. If we end your plan for a reason that is not your fault, for example we stop offering a treatment or your state is no longer served, we refund any charge for a month in which you did not receive what you paid for. If we end it because you gave false information or misused the service, Section 5.6 applies.
5. Refunds

blocks.heading: Full refund if your clinician does not prescribe.
blocks.text: If your clinician decides not to prescribe treatment, we refund everything you paid for that order, including any tax. You do not need to ask. This also applies if your clinician cannot finish the review because you did not send information they asked for within [14 days], and if your clinician does not renew your prescription for a month we have charged. We start the refund within [2 business days] after the decision. [ALTERNATIVE A: charge only after approval] [ALTERNATIVE B: non-refundable consult fee, amount to be set]

blocks.heading: You change your mind before the pharmacy starts.
blocks.text: If the pharmacy has not started preparing your medication, you can cancel the order and we refund the charge in full. Ask as soon as you can (Section 5.8).

blocks.heading: Pharmacy error.
blocks.text: If you receive the wrong medication, strength or amount, do not use it. Contact the pharmacy named on the label and support@wellpeps.com right away. The pharmacy will confirm the error. If your clinician agrees a corrected order is right for you, the pharmacy sends it at no charge. If a corrected order cannot be sent, or you prefer, we refund that month’s charge.

blocks.heading: Lost, damaged or heat-exposed shipment.
blocks.text: If a package is damaged, was exposed to heat, or arrives with a broken seal or leak, do not use the medication. Contact the pharmacy and support@wellpeps.com within [48 hours] after it arrives. If a package does not arrive, contact us within [7 days] after the expected delivery date. Send photos of the package and the label if you can. The pharmacy decides whether the product is safe to use, and your clinician confirms that a replacement is appropriate. We send a replacement at no charge or, if a replacement cannot be sent, refund that month’s charge. See the Shipping and Delivery Policy for what to check when your package arrives.

blocks.heading: Backorders and shortages.
blocks.text: If a medication is on backorder or the pharmacy cannot fill your order, we tell you. You can wait, ask your clinician whether another option is right for you (your clinician decides), or cancel and receive a full refund of the order that was not filled. If your order has not shipped within [14 days] after we charged you, you can cancel it and receive a full refund.

blocks.heading: When we cannot refund.
blocks.text: We cannot refund a charge in these cases, unless the law says otherwise:

The pharmacy has already started preparing your medication, the medication was prepared and shipped as ordered, and nothing in Sections 5.3 to 5.5 applies. This includes a change of mind, side effects, a dose change or not getting the result you hoped for.
You want to return the medication. Compounded medication generally cannot be returned, restocked or sent out again once it has shipped.
Delivery failed because the address you gave was wrong or incomplete, you refused the package, or you did not collect it after repeated attempts.
The package was delivered as expected and later stored or left out in a way that does not follow your label.
Lab tests, which are billed separately and follow the lab partner’s rules. [VERIFY: lab partner refund terms]
We closed your account because you gave false health or identity information or misused the service, as to medication already prepared.
Nothing in this policy limits a refund right you have under state or federal law that cannot be waived.

blocks.heading: How and when we pay refunds.
blocks.text: We refund to the card you used at checkout. We start the refund within [2 business days] after we approve it. It usually appears on your statement within [5 to 10 business days], depending on your bank or card issuer. [VERIFY: processor refund timing] We email you when the refund is issued. If your card has been closed, contact us and we will find another way to pay you.

blocks.heading: How to ask for a refund.
blocks.text: Email support@wellpeps.com or send a message in your patient portal. Tell us your name, the email on your account, the charge date and what happened. We reply within 1 business day. You do not need to use special words.
6. Price changes and promotional pricing

blocks.heading: Your monthly price.
blocks.text: Your price is the price you saw at checkout. A change of dose alone does not change your price, and neither does a change of pharmacy. If your clinician prescribes a different medication, form or strength that has a different price, we show you the new price and ask for your agreement before we charge any different amount. You can say no, and you will not be charged the different amount. [VERIFY: GEN product price stays fixed when dose or pharmacy changes]

blocks.heading: If the price goes up.
blocks.text: We will tell you in writing at least [30 days] before a higher price takes effect. The notice is sent by email and shown in your patient portal. It states your current price, the new price, the date it starts and how to cancel. The new price applies only to renewals on or after that date. If you cancel before that date, you will not pay the new price. Where a state’s law requires your fresh agreement to a higher price, we will ask for it and will not charge the higher price until you agree.

blocks.heading: Promotional prices.
blocks.text: We do not offer introductory prices or free trials today. If we ever do, checkout will show the promotional price, how long it lasts, the regular price that follows and the date it starts. We will email you [3 to 21 days] before a promotional price ends. “Free” is used only for the health assessment, with the refund rule shown next to it.

blocks.heading: Labs and tax.
blocks.text: Lab tests are never part of your monthly price. When your clinician recommends labs, the lab fee is shown and billed separately. Tax is added where the law requires it.
7. Failed payments
If a charge fails, we email you. You can update your card in the patient portal.
We may try the charge again up to [3 attempts] over [10 days]. We do not charge a late fee. [VERIFY: processor retry rules and late-fee position]
We do not send a new order to the pharmacy until the payment goes through.
If the payment is still unpaid after [10 days], we cancel your plan and tell you in writing. You can restart at any time (Section 4.5).
A failed payment never takes back medication that has already been shipped to you. You can still message your clinician about your care. [VERIFY: Practice to confirm messaging access while unpaid]
8. Chargebacks and billing disputes

blocks.heading: Please contact us first.
blocks.text: If you think a charge is wrong, email support@wellpeps.com. We can often fix it faster than your bank can, and we will tell you what we find within 1 business day.

blocks.heading: Your rights stay yours.
blocks.text: You can always dispute a charge with your bank or card issuer. Nothing in this policy takes that right away.

blocks.heading: What we share.
blocks.text: If you dispute a charge, we send your card issuer the records it needs: the order, your agreement to the renewal terms, the charge and delivery details. We do not send your health information except where the law allows.

blocks.heading: Disputes we have already refunded.
blocks.text: If you dispute a charge that we already refunded or that this policy allows, we may pause new orders until the dispute is resolved. We may close an account after repeated disputes of charges that were correct. [VERIFY: Counsel to confirm]
9. Your rights under state law
Some states give extra protection for plans that renew automatically. If a law of your state gives you more than this policy, we follow that law for you.

**The law behind this policy.** In July 2025 a federal court struck down a federal rule called “Click-to-Cancel.” A different federal law, ROSCA, and many state laws still apply, and federal and state officials are enforcing them. We follow ROSCA and the strictest state rule we know of. [VERIFY: current FTC rulemaking status]

Appendix A. Checkout disclosure and consent (internal: for whoever builds the checkout)
A.1 Rules this wording must meet

**ROSCA** requires that all material terms are disclosed clearly and conspicuously before billing information is collected, that the patient gives express informed consent before being charged, and that stopping the charges is simple.
**State automatic-renewal laws** (section 9) add separate consent, a retained acknowledgment, reminders, price-change notices and online cancellation. Where they differ, build to the most protective.
**The FTC’s Click-to-Cancel rule** was vacated by the Eighth Circuit in July 2025 and is not relied on. ROSCA and the state laws are still enforced. [VERIFY: current FTC rulemaking status]

blocks.text: Test script (run before launch and after any GEN update)

items: Run a full order in test mode on desktop Chrome, iPhone Safari and Android Chrome. Screenshot every step.
Confirm the disclosure shows before the card fields and directly above the checkbox, that the box starts unchecked, and that the pay button stays disabled until it is checked.
Confirm the amounts in the disclosure, the button, the receipt and the charge are identical.
Confirm the acknowledgment email (B1) arrives immediately with the correct merge fields and a working cancel link.
Cancel by portal message and by email. Confirm B5 arrives within 1 business day, no later charge is made, and the cancellation is time-stamped.
Deny a test order and confirm the refund workflow runs, B6 is sent and the money returns.
Fail a test card and confirm the failed-payment notice and retry behavior match section 7.
File the screenshots and logs in the compliance record.
